_readme: Single site-wide conversion rate. Update monthly via refresh.ts (records the previous value in history). Round INR to natural price points (₹49/99/149/199/299/499/999) only when presenting a converted USD price as an INR reference; never round a device-checked INR price.
source: RBI reference rate, 2026-09-25. RBI reference rate as reported 2026-09-25 (1 USD = 95.892 INR). A 2026-09-11 reading of 95.725 corroborates the level. Gathered by web search; WebFetch to rbi.org.in is blocked by this environment's egress proxy, so re-verify against the primary page before a price fact cites this rate (G02).
